package_info.why_malicious: Not malicious. Vigil is a security scanner designed to detect prompt injection and jailbreak attacks in LLM prompts and responses. The tool is intended to improve security, not to perform malicious actions.

behavioral_signatures: N/A – This package is not malicious. It scans for prompt injection and jailbreak attempts in LLM prompts.
file_indicators: N/A – No suspicious files or behaviors described.
network_indicators: N/A – No suspicious network activity described.
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Vigil is a legitimate security tool. No detection is required unless it is being abused or repackaged with malicious intent. If Vigil is found in an environment where it is not expected, review its configuration and usage to ensure it is not being misused.
